name: GPU-accelerated UPBP with RTX BVH
aliases: Robust Volumetric Light Transport Simulation GPU
definition: A full GPU implementation of Unbiased Path-Based Photon (UPBP) rendering that uses a new Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS) weight algorithm and accelerated data structures, leveraging NVIDIA RTX hardware for light and camera path generation.
summary: GPU-accelerated UPBP with RTX BVH is a full GPU implementation of the UPBP algorithm that uses NVIDIA RTX hardware and BVH structures to solve volumetric light transport faster than CPU methods.
